SudachiDict Core-derived candidate index (version 20260723)

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

Upstream: https://github.com/WorksApplications/SudachiDict/tree/v20260723

Sumibi uses an extracted and transformed candidate index, not the full original
Sudachi dictionary. Common-noun surfaces containing kanji were selected from
small_lex.csv and core_lex.csv, readings converted to hiragana, duplicate surfaces
removed, and up to 32 surfaces per reading ranked by word cost.
The initial iOS adaptation was prepared on 2026-10-16.

The index is derived from third-party data and is not covered solely by Sumibi's
MIT license. See LICENSE-2.0.txt for the complete Apache license and LEGAL for
the original UniDic and NEologd copyright, redistribution, disclaimer and
attribution notices. Those original documents are included without modification.

Sumibi's separate BuiltinCandidates.tsv contains original MIT-licensed mappings
for the Japanese middle dot, and is not derived from SudachiDict.
